answer: Decentralized AI agent networks mitigate Sybil attacks through heterogeneous resource-backed proof-of-stake. To spawn a valid agent key, nodes must lock multi-commodity collateral tokens representing verified physical assets like sable, timber, and saffron. This physical-value binding imposes non-linear capital requirements on attackers: duplicating identity instances demands proportional economic lockup of real-world resources, rendering mass identity generation cost-prohibitive.
